# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** six or seven years old  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Dora has a neat and proper appearance, wearing a nicely starched white dress with a black sash. Her face features gentle, mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, and long, sleek curls that always stay in order.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is a demure, well-behaved, and exceptionally quiet child who always comports herself like a model youngster. Notably prim and proper, she speaks only when spoken to and maintains a composed demeanor even in stressful moments. She is remarkably neat, faithful, and observant, never needing to be told how to do a task twice nor forgetting her duties. An industrious child, she finds joy in helping with small tasks, tending to her work in a careful, systematic, and dispassionate manner.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025)_

## History

Dora Keith was brought to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) alongside her twin brother [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), though early on she suffered from his mischief when he caused her to fall into a pigpen and later locked her in a toolhouse. Unlike her unruly brother, Dora was noted for her quiet perfection. She was frightened at school by a classmate's ghost stories, but her future at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) was eventually secured when her relative [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) passed away and left trust money allowing her and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to stay permanently.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P26](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0026), +14 more_

## Relationships

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

Dora is the twin sister of [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), whom [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) brings home to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) frequently targets Dora with his unruly mischief, which includes causing her to fall into a pigpen and locking her in a toolhouse, prompting frantic searches by the household. While Dora is noted for her quiet perfection, Davy's constant troublemaking creates a sharp contrast between the siblings.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +18 more_
